stories.headline: Parliamentary budget crisis threatens government coalition over PSD solidarity package
stories.summary: Major tensions between coalition partners PSD and PNL over the 2026 state budget, with PSD demanding amendments for a 'solidarity package' providing aid to pensioners and families. Parliamentary committee votes have been chaotic, with walkouts, vote reversals, and threats from both parties to exit the government.

articles.title: Scandal în comisia pentru buget din Parlament. Amendamentul PSD privind ajutorul unic pentru pensionari a fost respins

stories.headline: Marcel Ciolacu launches sustained attack campaign against PM Ilie Bolojan over fuel prices and budget policy
stories.summary: Former PM and current PSD regional leader Marcel Ciolacu has escalated personal attacks against current PM Ilie Bolojan, calling him a 'satrap' and 'călău' while criticizing government handling of rising fuel prices and fiscal policy. Ciolacu suggests the 'Bolojan era' is approaching its end.

articles.title: Marcel Ciolacu s-a uitat peste bugetul pregătit de Ilie Bolojan și a explodat: Un satrap cu satâr! Este cruzime pură!
De ziua lui Bolojan, Ciolacu îi cântă prohodul. „Liberalii se solidarizează cu un călău"

stories.headline: AUR emerges as parliamentary kingmaker amid coalition budget disputes
stories.summary: George Simion's AUR party has become the decisive swing vote in parliamentary budget debates, sometimes supporting PSD amendments and sometimes opposing them. Despite declining poll numbers, AUR's 35% support still makes it the most popular party, while Simion positions the party as an alternative to the troubled coalition.

articles.title: Sondaj Avangarde: AUR e pe primul loc, dar în scădere față de precedentele sondaje

stories.headline: Iran threatens Romania over US military base usage as NATO tensions escalate
stories.summary: Iran issued formal warnings to Romania over allowing the United States to use military bases for operations in the Middle East conflict. Romania rejected Iranian threats while maintaining its NATO commitments, as broader tensions emerge between Trump and European allies over support for Middle East operations.

stories.headline: President Nicușor Dan meets with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte amid regional security tensions
stories.summary: Romanian President Nicușor Dan held talks with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte at alliance headquarters in Brussels, discussing Eastern Flank security and regional threats. Rutte confirmed he will attend the upcoming Bucharest 9 summit in Romania, while both officials emphasized Romania's strategic importance to NATO.

stories.headline: Central Bank warns of mounting economic pressures as external debt rises to €229 billion
stories.summary: The National Bank of Romania reported that external debt increased by €1.986 billion in January 2026 to reach €229.33 billion total. BNR officials warned about fiscal deficit risks and the need for political stability, while also issuing alerts about fraudulent lending schemes using the bank's name.

stories.headline: Romanian Armed Forces conduct major Black Sea exercises with 13 NATO allies
stories.summary: Over 2,500 military personnel from Romania and 12 other NATO states participated in the multinational Sea Shield 2026 exercise in the Black Sea region. The exercise included forces from France, Germany, Spain, the US, and Turkey, demonstrating alliance cooperation amid regional tensions.

stories.headline: INSCOP poll reveals majority of Romanians support remaining in NATO and EU
stories.summary: A new INSCOP Research survey found that 11.8% of Romanians believe the country should leave NATO while 22.2% think Romania should exit the European Union. However, the vast majority support continued membership in both organizations, with AUR voters most likely to favor withdrawal.

articles.title: Câți români ar fi de acord ca țara noastră să iasă din NATO și din Uniunea Europeană

stories.headline: Romanian paramilitaries join Russian forces after leader's arrest
stories.summary: Fighters from the Romanian paramilitary firm Asociatia RALF have been recruited into Russian armed forces and the Africa Corps following the arrest of their leader, French-Romanian former legionnaire Horațiu Potra, according to intelligence reports.

stories.summary: A 34-year-old Iranian man and 31-year-old Romanian woman were charged after attempting to enter HM Naval Base Clyde, the UK's nuclear submarine facility in Scotland, according to Police Scotland.

stories.headline: Romania leads NATO procurement program with Rheinmetall contracts worth billions
stories.summary: Under the EU's Security Action for Europe (SAFE) loan scheme, Romania is set to receive around EUR 9.6 billion for defense procurement, with over half likely going to German defense contractor Rheinmetall. The initiative includes major acquisitions like the KF41 Lynx infantry fighting vehicles.

stories.summary: Ukraine's Naftogaz is in discussions with Romania's OMV Petrom about developing a Black Sea offshore gas project. The cooperation is part of broader energy and defense collaboration between the two countries, with work potentially starting after the war ends.
